title: ZIP data descriptor with local header zero length
summary: General flag bit 3 indicates that the CRC and size can be given in the data descriptor after the file data.
detail: When the local header has zero length, the member record can be determined based on the judgment of the corresponding member in the central directory and bit 3.
boundary: The descriptor signature 0x08074b50 is optional and the delimitation cannot be determined by this byte string alone.
relevance: Distinguish between a truly empty file and a non-null member that is streamed.
